        vals = torch.randn(7, N, generator=torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)).to(torch.float16).cuda()
        out = k.run(vals)

        refc = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
        tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*refc.abs()
        err = (out.double() - refc).abs()
        nonfinite |= bool((~torch.isfinite(out)).any())
        fail = err > tol
        any_fail |= bool(fail.any())
        m = err.max().item()
        if m > worst:
            worst = m; idx = (err == err.max()).nonzero()[0].tolist(); worst_loc = idx
    results[f"N{N}"] = {"worst_abs_err": worst, "worst_loc": worst_loc, "tol_violation": any_fail, "nonfinite_output": nonfinite}
print(json.dumps(results))", "expected_signal": "per-frequency max abs error vs tolerance 1e-4+1e-6*|ref| across N in {64,128,256}"}

{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, json, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kernel", "/root/cases/case_162/kernel.py")
k = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(k)
results = {}
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    vals = torch.randn(5, N, generator=torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(11)).to(torch.float16).cuda()
    out = k.run(vals)
    # exact Nyquist: sum_j (-1)^j x[j] computed in float64 on the exact fp16 values
    signs = torch.tensor([(-1.0)**j for j in range(N)], dtype=torch.float64)
    nyq = (vals.double().cpu() * signs).sum(dim=1)
    got = out[:, N//2, 0].double().cpu()
    imag_got = out[:, N//2, 1].double().cpu()
    tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*nyq.abs()
    err = (got - nyq).abs()
    results[f"N{N}"] = {
        "nyquist_real_max_err": err.max().item(),
        "tolerance": tol.min().item(),
        "violations": int((err > tol).sum()),
        "imag_max_abs": imag_got.abs().max().item(),
        "ref_nyquist": nyq.tolist()[:3],
        "got_nyquist": got.tolist()[:3],
    }
print(json.dumps(results))", "expected_signal": "Nyquist bin values vs exact sum (-1)^j x[j] and imaginary component zero"}

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kernel", "/root/cases/case_162/kernel.py")
k = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(k)
results = {}
# extreme magnitude inputs, several patterns, N=256 and 128
cases = {
 "all65504_N256": torch.full((4, 256), 65504.0, dtype=torch.float16),
 "alt_extreme_N256": torch.tensor([65504.0, -65504.0]*(256*4), dtype=torch.float16).reshape(4, 256),
 "mix_extreme_N256": (torch.randn(4, 256, generator=torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(5)).to(torch.float16) * 65504.0).clamp(-65504, 65504).to(torch.float16),
 "alt_extreme_N128": torch.tensor([65504.0, -65504.0]*(128*4), dtype=torch.float16).reshape(4, 128),
}
for name, vals_cpu in cases.items():
    vals = vals_cpu.cuda()
    out = k.run(vals)
    ref = torch.fft.rfft(vals.double().cpu(), dim=1)
    refc = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1).cuda()
    tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*refc.abs()
    err = (out.double() - refc).abs()
    rel = (err / refc.abs().clamp_min(1e-30)).max().item()
    results[name] = {
        "max_abs_err": err.max().item(),
        "max_rel_err": rel,
        "tol_violations": int((err > tol).sum()),
        "nonfinite_out": bool((~torch.isfinite(out)).any()),
        "max_out_mag": out.abs().max().item(),
    }
print(json.dumps(results))", "expected_signal": "max relative error vs 1e-6 relative tolerance for FP16-extreme inputs"}
